paper_code_agreements: Token-level ECS is cosine similarity between final-layer current-token state and the mean final-layer state of top-attended context tokens.
The selected proportion is top 10 percent.
Token-level PKS compares LogitLens vocabulary distributions before and after each FFN.
The final detector is a positive PKS term minus a positive ECS term; response-native pooling is token mean.
The published RAGTruth Llama2-7B Token settings are Khead=1, Klayer=10, alpha=1, beta=0.2.
